name: Croissance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Croissance Limited is engaged in Realty operating services and trading in infrastructure materials.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company undertakes complete turnkey projects for villas and apartments and customizes wardrobes, entertainment 
units, modular kitchens and built-in 
furniture. At present, company has 
completed 350+ projects with 60+ 
new designs for 310+ clients

cons: Stock is trading at 32.8 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -13.8% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.42% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 13,906 days.
